sloka: न मन्ये ब्रह्म चर्ये अस्ति स्वधीते वा फल उदयः ।मार्दव आर्जवयोः वा अपि त्वाम् चेद् व्यसनम् आगतम् ॥२-५२-१७॥
transliteration: na manye brahma carye asti svadhīte vā phala udayaḥ ।mārdava ārjavayoḥ vā api tvām ced vyasanam āgatam ॥2-52-17॥

translations.english: If your celibacy and your grief are the consequences of your study of the Vedic lore, your compassionate nature and simplicity of character, I think there is no use of all these (virtues).
